description: Evidence-driven refinement of late/unstable optimistic_adam: store each players previous RAW gradient, feed 2*g_t-g_previous into ordinary Adam before both first/second-moment updates, then restore raw .grad. First call uses ordinary gradient. All original D/G/prior groups, losses and scheduled rates remain; prediction magnitude now contributes to its own Adam second moment. No extra evaluations or updates.
initialization: retained audited CPU fixtures; native CUDA training and random draws

compute.base_updates: one D and one G per host outer step; no added critic steps
compute.comparison: equal outer steps and equal model/gradient evaluations; added tensor arithmetic/memory, wall time measured

checkpoint: memory stored in optimizer state; qualification continuation required after all 22
